_comment: FAKE example numbers for development only. Real SLA values are NEVER committed in the clear (decisions/0004); the real thresholds.json is gitignored and delivered at test time. Shares schema_version + provenance.kb_git_commit with catalog.tr-virt-018.json so they join.

sla.condition: 100 VMs, 2 disks each (30Gi rhel9 root + 10Gi blank data), datasource-clone; p99 per-VM clone duration (computed from per-VM samples). Completeness (every VM succeeds) is enforced natively, not gated here.
